info.name: Ride Backend API
info.description: Ride backend (Fiber v2 + Postgres) featuring strict realm separation between App Users (passengers & drivers) and Staff (admin & support). Every HTTP route starts with /api/v1. Operations: reports, SOS/safety, mobile-money finance, and fraud review. Set stable test UUIDs and local secrets in collection variables; never store production credentials in this collection.

item.name: Promos and Referrals
item.description: Staff realm: admin writes; support GET only. App realm: passenger only. Share uses a no-op notifier. Dates in examples may need updating. For referral apply, use a DIFFERENT new verified passenger token from the referrer. No ride endpoints exist; integration hooks are documented in README.

item.name: App Realm
item.description: App realm for drivers and passengers. Tokens carry iss='ride-backend', aud='app'.

item.name: Get Licence Document (Owning Driver or Staff only)
Staff Realm
item.description: Staff realm for admin and support members. Completely isolated from app realm. Tokens carry iss='ride-backend', aud='staff'.

item.name: Final Driver Approval (Claim Owner, After Document Review)
Data Protection
item.description: Passenger token for own-account actions. Request bodies require current_password, except passwordless Google users may use a token issued within five minutes. Admins manage requests; support is read-only.

item.name: Phase 6 — Reports and blocks
item.description: App requires app tokens. Report moderation is staff-only; support temporary account actions are capped at seven days.

request.description: Optional user={{user_id}} restricts the queue to reports involving an account. Combine with status, category, assignee and priority; use limit/offset for pagination.

item.name: Phase 7 — SOS and incidents
item.description: Public share lookup has no bearer token and returns the same 404 for invalid/expired tokens.

request.description: Use status=open for the live queue. Increment offset by limit to see all alerts, including queues larger than 100; ordering is escalation level, age, then UUID.

item.name: Phase 8 — Payments and finance
item.description: Every money-moving POST carries Idempotency-Key. Provider webhook is HMAC signed in the pre-request script using payment_webhook_secret.

request.description: Whole TZS only. Partial refunds of discounted rides reverse the rounded gross fare, commission and promo subsidy with balanced positive ledger entries. Preserve the same Idempotency-Key when retrying a request; this sample generates a new key for a new request.

item.name: Approve refund (admin or below configured support limit)
Phase 9 — Fraud review
item.description: Support can triage and dismiss low-severity flags. Admin controls holds, confirmation and rule changes.
